legacy_equivalence.defaults: tomocpt train without cv_all_folds is unchanged (run.py dispatches only when the flag is set; tomocpt.training.cv is not imported otherwise, G4c-C1). _do_chunking_v2 output unchanged (val_tomograms / layout code moved into helpers; pool=False path identical; G4b-C3 and Gate 2 tests).
behaviour_changes_v2_only: calibrate_checkpoint (post-fit calibration of every pipeline-v2 training) also writes <ckpt stem>.val_picks.npz next to the checkpoint and loads the checkpoint through isolated_checkpoint_load

build_ensemble / load_ensemble load members with their own train settings (no CLI snapshot changes applied to members) and build_ensemble writes oof_picks.npz next to the ensemble file (record key oof_picks)

metrics.c8_cv_mode: 3 folds x 1 epoch, tiny model, 6 phantoms: pool chunked once, fold dirs are symlinks, ensemble reused all saved picks (0 re-predictions), rerun trained nothing and gave the same thresholds

pytest_fast.tests -m 'not slow': 794 passed, 27 skipped after the re-freeze (before: 1 failed, G4b-C5 softmax; dispute accepted by human 4 Nov 2026)

known_limitations: Fold processes run sequentially on the visible GPUs (each fold may use DDP itself); folds are not run in parallel.
Localisation in the report uses the coordinate CSV truths, which are floored to whole voxels until TODO 3b.1.
Filament classes are reported like particle classes (F-beta of their traced points); peak profiles are computed for particle classes only.
A pool is reused when its settings match; adding tomograms to the training data needs a new chunks_dir or deleting the pool (link_fold_chunks raises ValueError naming the missing tomograms).
Unfinished folds restart from scratch (no mid-fold resume).
